name: Protein models docking benchmark 2
description: A benchmark dataset for assessing docking performance when one or both protein partners are modeled rather than experimentally determined.
evaluation_method: DockQ / interface RMSD / success rate at defined RMSD thresholds (CAPRI-style metrics)
general_score_metric: DockQ (commonly reported), along with RMSD-based success rates
typical_sota_score: varies widely depending on modeling errors; no single unified SOTA
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used in the protein docking community to assess performance when modeled structures are used; referenced in structural bioinformatics work.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; evaluates docking with modeled (not experimental) structures so results can be strongly affected by input model quality. Dataset size and diversity affect generalization; specialized to structural biology tasks.
